examples.arabic: عمتي جابت خبز طازج و صحن سلطة فيه بصل و توم و كتير زيت زيتون
examples.english: My aunt brought fresh bread and a bowl of salad with onions, garlic, and plenty of olive oil.
examples.transliteration: 'Ammati jābat khubz ṭāzej w ṣaḥn salaṭa fīh baṣal w tūm w ktīr zeit zeitoun.

examples.arabic: بالأول قطعت البصل وبعدين قليت الدجاج وسمعت صوت الطقطقة
examples.english: First I chopped the onions, then I fried the chicken and heard the sizzling sound.
examples.transliteration: Bel-awwal qaṭṭa't el-baṣal w ba'dein qaleit ed-djaj w same't ṣawt eṭ-ṭaqṭaqa.

examples.arabic: حاولت احكي مع البياع عن سعر البصل بس هو كان عم يحكي مع موبايله
examples.english: I tried to speak with the vendor about the price of onions, but he was speaking with his phone.
examples.transliteration: Hawalt ahki ma' l-bayya' 'an se'er l-basal, bas huwwe kan 'am yehki ma' mobailo.
